name: Henry Louis Vivian Derozio
role: Teacher, poet, and early Bengal Renaissance intellectual
contribution: At Hindu College he encouraged critical inquiry among students later associated with the Young Bengal circle.
context: Early nineteenth-century Calcutta education and reform debates.
impact: His short teaching career became a marker of new secular, rationalist, and reformist currents in colonial Bengal.
highlight: A central name behind the Derozian current of Young Bengal.
